description:
Directly connect more Wireshark and Logray main window signals and
slots.

This causes the following error on exit, if I have the search frame open:

> ** (wireshark:2104515) 12:16:46.556019 [GUI ERROR] /usr/include/qt6/QtCore/qobjectdefs_impl.h:129 -- ASSERT failure in WiresharkMainWindow: "Called object is not of the correct type (class destructor may have already run)", file /usr/include/qt6/QtCore/qobjectdefs_impl.h, line 129

> ** (wireshark:2104515) Aborting on fatal log level exception
Aborted (core dumped)

I do not get it with the old style signals and slots. It has something to do with the `~WiresharkMainWindow()` destructor having already run and deleted `main_ui_` (and thus `packet_list_`)
